summary: Add a provider-neutral mobile warehouse projection over canonical WMS/fulfillment records with digest-only scans, pack/print intents, FBS/FBO ownership and offline-safe receipts.

impacts.evidence: All mobile projections carry organization/workspace scope and forced RLS.
Raw barcode/DataMatrix values are transient; persisted scan evidence is digest-only.
Mobile plan, batch, scan, pack, print, device, offline and observation contracts are additive and SDK-generated.
Three versioned mobile event payload contracts use the existing transactional outbox.
Provider-neutral FBS/FBO modes and mobile operation boundaries avoid provider branches.
Migration 56 is expand-only, backup-gated, catalog-hashed and adds no stock ledger.
Device revoke, permission split, RLS, append-only evidence and version controls are enforced.
Print/reprint and handoff remain explicit boundaries; FBO remote work cannot be local execution.
Plan, task, device, location, package/print digest, versions and observations are auditable.
Idempotency keys, optimistic versions, offline receipts and unknown states preserve replay safety.
Physical printer, carrier and marketplace calls remain external qualified connector work.
Mobile summary exposes active plans, task exceptions, print backlog and offline backlog.
Scan and remote observations are append-only; unknown effects are reconciled.
Core/repository/API/contract/frontend/static gates cover the repository boundary; live hardware evidence remains external.
